subject: FY24 School District Budget
overview: The Medford School Committee met as a Committee of the Whole to review a second presentation on the proposed FY24 school budget. Committee members discussed rising fixed costs, expiring federal ESSER grant funds, and district staffing priorities.

items.title: FY24 Budget Presentation and Committee Discussion
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Edouard-Vincent presented the second FY24 budget update outlining contractual salary increases, rising special education and transportation expenses, and expiring ESSER grant funds, after which committee members requested detailed breakdowns of grant usage and revolving accounts.
